The [[Deatheater Longbow]] is a [[unique item|unique]] [[bow]] dropped by [[Rendabi Deatheater]], a [[boss]] who can be found in [[The Ruptured Heart]].

==Stats==
:[[Piercing damage]]: 15-28 (Requires 9 [[Marksmanship]])
:Lengthens [[Crippled]] duration on foes by 33% (Stacking)
:[[Energy]] +5
:[[Health]] +30

==Skin==
This item has the same skin as a [[Platinum Longbow]] [[dye]]d white.

==Replica==
Except for the visual appearance, it is possible to create an exact technical replica for this item with:
*One of the following [[longbow]]s:
**[[Longbow (wooden)|Longbow]] from crafters [[Vaughn]] or [[Shichiroji]]
**[[Wooden Longbow]] from collector [[Kurmauzeh]] or crafter [[Ruricu]]
*[[Crippling]] [[Bow String]]
*[[Perfect]] [[Bow Grip]] [[of Fortitude]]
OR
*One of the following [[longbow]]s:
**[[Wooden Longbow]] from crafters [[Asa]], [[Bolereh]], [[Derrick]], [[Hadusi]], [[Rahmdah]], [[Sende]], [[Shausha]], [[Soros]], or [[Tehshan]]
**[[Asuran Longbow]] from crafter [[Nojj]]
**[[Balthazar's Longbow]] from collector [[Zaishen Martial Weapon Master]]
**[[Deldrimor Longbow]] from crafter [[Grand Mason Stonecleaver]]
**[[Longbow of Purity]] from collector [[Iza Yoi]]
**[[Maplewood Longbow]] from crafter [[Hulen Hairyback]]
**[[Norn Longbow]] from crafter [[Keti]]
**[[Oppressor's Longbow]] from collector [[Lionguard (collector)|Lionguard]]
**[[Charr Longbow]] from collector [[Tuomas]] (requires [[Bonus Mission Pack]])
**[[Mursaat Longbow]] from collector [[Diane]] (requires Bonus Mission Pack)
**[[Tengu Longbow]] from collector [[Akemi]] (requires Bonus Mission Pack)
**[[Undead Longbow]] from collector [[Archivist of Whispers]] (requires Bonus Mission Pack)
*[[Crippling]] [[Bow String]]
*[[Perfect]] [[Bow Grip]] [[of Fortitude]]
*[[Perfect]] "[[Inscription|I have the power!]]" inscription

==Unique counterparts==
[[Koahm's Flatbow]] and [[Bolten's Recurve Bow]] have stats identical to this item; however, they are different bow classes.
